# tabdo

> An AI-native workspace for individuals and small teams, built on flexible data. Agents help organize information, arrange steps, and execute operations; people inspect and adjust results.

## Docs

- [Docs index](https://tabdo.ai/docs/llms.txt): Full documentation map for agents.
- [Welcome](https://tabdo.ai/docs): For AI Agents / For Humans dual entry.
